parsed.post: New personal best! 0.988114 achieved by keeping LR=0.03 and ASPECT_RATIO=64. The downward LR trend and the width increase are both contributing to better results. Next, I will test if even lower learning rates (LR=0.02) can improve upon this combined config.
parsed.description: Probing the lower bound of the learning rate curve by reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.03 to 0.02 on the current best width/LR configuration.
